snippet.title: Abandoned Stories: Inherited Silence Trailer - New Steam Horror Game
snippet.description:
Steam Link
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4478760/Abandoned_Stories_Inherited_Silence

About This Game
Can you survive the night in a house that doesn’t want you there?

Trapped inside a quiet home with something watching you, Maria must uncover the truth behind a growing nightmare.

Explore every corner, solve unsettling puzzles, and survive unpredictable events in this retro-inspired psychological horror experience.

Nothing is random. Nothing is safe. And someone is always closer than you think.

🕹️ Features:

• Retro PS1-inspired visuals with immersive atmosphere

• Randomly triggered events that keep every playthrough tense

• Exploration and puzzle-driven gameplay

• A dark, psychological horror story

• Multiple endings based on your choices
